skill.name: Breath of Fire
skill.description: Every 12 seconds after the start of the battle deal remaining 6-10% of hp.

skill.name: Time Freeze
skill.description: After 8 seconds from the start of the battle stop time for 4-10 seconds. Once per battle.

skill.name: Wilderness Roar
skill.description: Increase skill damage to boss monsters by 10-80%.

skill.name: Gold Rumble
skill.description: 10-80% chance of obtaining 2x gold whenever acquired.

skill.name: Judge's Torpedo
skill.description: Instantly kills normal monsters with less than 14-30% HP.

skill.name: Leveling
skill.description: Increases damage dealt to enemies by 10-80% when the enemy's HP is above 70%.

skill.name: Understanding of the Abyss
skill.description: When gaining exp 10-80% chance for double exp.

skill.name: Thief Wind
skill.description: When attacking a normal monster for the first time, HP is reduced by 13-25%.

skill.name: Last Fight
skill.description: 5 seconds before the end of a battle increase your damage by 1.2-2X.
